text: Let me run the tests on all pages, using the others as comparison pages.
I'm partway through testing. Pages 1 and 2 are done except for the follow-up calls. Pages 3 and 4 are running. I'm starting page 5 now.
Still waiting on the last two page runs (NACA and KSC history). I'll keep checking.
All five page runs are finished and their questions answered. I'm now running the follow-up 19.A (Multiple Ways) checks.

I tested all five pages. Results are agent-assisted and are not a certified Trusted Tester result.

**What failed**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** this failed on careers, missions, artemis-iii and ksc-history. Each page starts with the repeated header block (the "Explore" button, search box, logo and menus), and the test found no keyboard way to skip it. On the NACA page the test was inconclusive, so that one is NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions:** this failed on all five pages. The header search box ("Search", reached after 2 Tabs) has only grey placeholder text as its label, and the label disappears when you type. On the NACA page the search box is reached after 9 Tabs.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible:** this failed on artemis-iii and the NACA page. The test found elements that show no focus indicator but did not name them, so I list the elements as "unnamed".
- **1.3.1 and 4.1.2 (missions):** the test reported form fields or buttons whose names don't say what they are for or leave out visible instructions. The fields weren't identified in the results I saw. The page has 101 fields and buttons, and only the first 60 were checked.

**Not finished**
- **2.4.5 Multiple Ways:** every page is NEEDS_REVIEW. The test found only one way to reach careers, artemis-iii, the NACA page and ksc-history (site search), and none for missions, within the pages I gave it. Those pages weren't a complete site map, so this needs a person.
- **Missions, 3.2.2 On Input:** I didn't run the extra check. The page has 98 form fields, and the check needs a run with no time limit that takes many minutes. I didn't run it without your go-ahead, so it stays NEEDS_REVIEW. Say if you want it run.
- **Missions, 3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4:** NEEDS_REVIEW. The page has a form that sends data to a server, and the test can't see the server's answer. Someone needs to submit it with mistakes on the live site.
- **2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide:** NEEDS_REVIEW on most pages. The auto-updating check couldn't be completed. On the NACA page I judged the pulsing "Scroll to continue" icons not essential, but I couldn't tell whether the hero animation runs past 5 seconds.
- **Focus Order (2.4.3):** NEEDS_REVIEW on artemis-iii and the NACA page. The video player order and the Shift+Tab order were unclear. I answered "unsure" instead of guessing a pass.

**Two judgment calls to know about**
- **2.4.6 Headings and Labels:** I recorded DNA on careers, artemis-iii-style pages and ksc-history because the tool found no visible field label to judge. A person may want to recheck this, since the missing label is already failed under 3.3.2.
- **3.2.4 Consistent Identification:** the tool matched some menu buttons only by position (for example "Featured Careers" against "Artemis"). I judged those to be different controls, not inconsistent naming.
